request: Analyze GSE193432 for PMID 35282369 (Exercise-Generated beta-Aminoisobutyric Acid (BAIBA) Reduces Cardiomyocyte Metabolic Stress and Apoptosis Caused by Mitochondrial Dysfunction Through the miR-208b/AMPK Pathway.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk mRNA-seq of rat left-ventricular myocardium, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2 + featureCounts (S2.15.p1)

group: HF + treadmill exercise (60 min/day, 5 d/wk, 8 wk, 50-60% max)

final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 per group in GEO (12 samples); Fig 5A states n = 3 for BAIBA vs HF
final.tissue_note: anterior LV wall; in the BAIBA group the peri-infarct area was used (S2.15.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of treadmill exercise on the myocardial transcriptome of rats with post-MI heart failure: HF+Exercise vs HF+Sedentary (abstract ABS.p3 compares 'exercised' with 'Sham (non-exercised) HF'). The paper's only reported RNA-seq DEG result is the exercise-mimetic BAIBA arm vs non-exercised HF (S3.4.p1, Fig 5).
planned_contrasts: HF+Exercise vs HF+Sedentary (exercise effect; paper's estimand for exercise, ABS.p3 / S3.1-S3.2; no RNA-seq DEG count reported)

HF+BAIBA vs HF+Sedentary (S3.4.p1, Fig 5A-C: 11 up, 18 down = 29 DEGs; text says 'compared to the Sham group' but Fig 5A says 'BAIBA vs. HF group' and the paper calls the non-exercised HF group 'Sham (non-exercised) HF' in ABS.p3)

paper_threshold_alternative.source_locator: S3.4.p1 (FC > 2.0, P < 0.05, stated with the 11/18 counts)

final.paper_method: DESeq2 (in-house pipeline, Shanghai Applied Protein Technology), two-group comparisons (S2.15.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.15.p1 describes RNA-seq: HISAT2/featureCounts, DESeq2, DEGs = |log2FC|>1 and Padj<0.05. S3.4.p1 reports 11 up / 18 down for BAIBA vs 'Sham' with 'FC > 2.0, P < 0.05'. Fig 5A legend says OPLS-DA 'BAIBA vs. HF group, n = 3', and S3.4.p1 says sequencing was performed 'in the HF and BAIBA groups', so the reported comparator is the non-exercised HF group. No exercise-arm RNA-seq result is reported, although GEO deposits the HF+Exercise arm; the paper's exercise estimand (ABS.p3, S3.1, S3.2) is exercised HF vs non-exercised HF.

checks: GEO: Rattus norvegicus SD heart, 4 groups x 3 (Sham, HF+Sedentary, HF+Exercise, HF+BAIBA) matches the paper's design
matrix column names HFExe/HFMed/HFSed/Sham-1..3 match GEO titles Heart, HF+Exe/HF+Med/HF+Sed/Sham, 1..3 (Med = BAIBA per source_name '--BAIBA')
contact: Dept of Rehabilitation, China-Japan Union Hospital, Changchun (Jilin University), matches S2.1.p1 ethics committee
data_processing names the Shanghai Applied Protein Technology in-house pipeline, as in S2.15.p1

ownership.reasoning: Accession cited in the data availability statement; groups, organism, tissue and pipeline all match.

final.method: exact match on a key derived from GEO title (Heart, HF+Exe, 1 -> HF_Exe_1) compared case/punctuation-insensitively with matrix columns (HFExe-1)

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (HFExe-1, HFMed-1, HFSed-1, Sham-1) encode group and replicate exactly as the GEO titles do; deriving the key from title and normalizing separators gives a one-to-one exact mapping, no positional alignment. grp comes from the treatment characteristic; HFMed in the matrix = HF+BAIBA (source_name '--BAIBA').

matrix.reasoning: integer_fraction 1.0, max 2.27e6, median 2; file named gene_count; GEO data_processing and S2.15.p1 state featureCounts read counts. FPKM is deposited separately (gene_fpkm, Allgene_info) and is not used for DE.

final.analysis_type: one factor, four levels; planned contrasts from one model

candidates.reason_rejected: mixes the MI effect with exercise; the paper's exercise comparison is within HF animals (ABS.p3)
BAIBA is a pharmacological mimetic, not exercise; levels are never pooled

candidates.value: HF+BAIBA vs Sham operation (literal reading of S3.4.p1 'compared to the Sham group')
candidates.reason_rejected: Fig 5A and S3.4.p1 say the sequencing comparison is BAIBA vs HF; kept only as an exploratory table from the joint model

design.reasoning: Exercise estimand is HF+Exercise vs HF+Sedentary (both MI-ligated, n=3 each). The paper's reported RNA-seq contrast HF+BAIBA vs HF+Sedentary is secondary (exercise-mimetic). One DESeq2 model ~ grp on all 12 samples with reference HFSed; other suitability comparisons are exploratory.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one heart each; no batch, lane or sex variation recorded (all male, S2.1.p1). No pairing.

deviations: joint ~grp model on all 12 samples as primary (paper's in-house pipeline probably fit each pair separately; pairwise two-arm DESeq2 runs as sensitivity)

method.reasoning: Raw featureCounts counts support the paper's DESeq2 route (S2.15.p1).

final.deviation_note: S2.15.p1 defines DEGs as |log2FC|>1 and Padj<0.05 (applied). S3.4.p1 reports the 11/18 counts with 'FC > 2.0, P < 0.05' (raw p); that rule is the audit threshold.

threshold.reasoning: Methods state the DEG rule explicitly; results restate it with raw P. Both are reported, applied = methods rule.

caveats: The paper reports no RNA-seq DEG result for the exercise arm; the exercise contrast has no paper count to compare.
BAIBA hearts were sampled from the peri-infarct area while other groups used the anterior LV wall (S2.15.p1): the BAIBA vs HF contrast confounds treatment with sampling site.
Paper threshold is internally inconsistent (Padj in methods, raw P in results).

study.reasoning: Paper counts: 11 up + 18 down BAIBA vs HF (S3.4.p1). Mir208b (ENSRNOG00000041381) up with BAIBA (Fig 5B) and altered by exercise by qPCR (Supplementary File 2A).

discrepancies.item: comparator of the reported DEG count
discrepancies.paper: S3.4.p1 text 'BAIBA ... compared to the Sham group'; Fig 5A 'BAIBA vs. HF group'
discrepancies.data: GEO has distinct Sham operation and HF+Sedentary groups

discrepancies.paper: no DEG result reported for exercise
BAIBA group: peri-infarct area; others: anterior LV wall (S2.15.p1)

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: one DESeq2 ~grp model on all 12 samples; planned HFExe vs HFSed (primary) and HFBAIBA vs HFSed (paper's reported contrast), other pairs exploratory

executions.name: pair_exe
executions.reasoning: two-arm DESeq2 on the six HF animals, as a commercial pairwise pipeline would fit

executions.name: pair_baiba
executions.reasoning: two-arm DESeq2 for the paper's reported BAIBA vs HF contrast, the likely paper route

enrichment.reasoning: exercise contrast pathways (paper discusses AMPK, fatty acid oxidation, apoptosis)
paper reports KEGG enrichment (AMPK) for BAIBA vs HF (S3.5, Fig 6F)
